ministry: Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Odisha
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹10,000 per year in two equal installments of ₹5,000 (on Raksha Bandhan and International Women's Day) totaling ₹50,000 over 5 years, plus a SUBHADRA Debit Card.
exclusions: Households owning more than 5 acres of irrigated land or 10 acres of non-irrigated land
Income tax payers or regular government employees
documents_required: Odisha Ration Card (NFSA / SFSS) or Residence Proof
application_steps: Obtain the free printed SUBHADRA form from an Anganwadi Centre, Block Office, or Mo Seba Kendra.
Submit the filled form at the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or Mo Seba Kendra for online digitization on subhadra.odisha.gov.in.
Complete biometric e-KYC to receive ₹5,000 bi-annual installments.
